title: CVE-2026-111943 (compromised intermediate CA) — upstream says upgrade immediately to v1.67.1 or v1.66.2

detection.reason: read from the image TAG of the ebs-csi-controller / ebs-csi-node workloads — a digest-pinned image (@sha256:…) or a mirror that renames the tag is not resolved and reads clean

quote: **We recommend users upgrade immediately to `v1.67.1` or `v1.66.2` of the EBS CSI Driver.**
remediation: Upgrade to v1.67.1 or later (or v1.66.2 on the 1.66 line): every earlier build trusts the compromised intermediate CA (CVE-2026-111943), so an attacker holding those keys could impersonate the AWS API to the controller and node plugin. Pick a target of at least v1.67.1 — v1.67.0 is not fixed.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("^ebs-csi-(controller|node(-.+)?)$")) | .metadata.namespace as $n | .metadata.name as $w | .spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.name == "ebs-plugin") | "\($n)/\($w): \(.image)"'  # a tag below v1.66.2, or v1.67.0, is a build without the CVE-2026-111943 fix
coversNotes: URGENT (1.66.2): This release fixes CVE-2026-111943 which resulted from the compromise of a trusted
